last_resort.title: Attended

awards.title: Chief Communications Officer
awards.line: {name} gestured {n}x and said nothing useful.

awards.line: {name} read {n} documents. Comprehension is not audited.

awards.title: Incident Participant

awards.line: {name} returned colleagues to service {n}x. Probation continues.

awards.title: Records Handler
awards.line: {name} dropped tapes {n}x. Handling is a journey.

awards.title: Lost Property Visitor
awards.line: {name} picked tapes up {n}x. The tapes were not consulted.

awards.title: Eye Contact Review
awards.line: {name} looked at the Orderly for {n}s. The Orderly has logged it.

awards.title: Steps Audit
awards.line: {name} walked {n} m. Footwear is the Company's concern.

awards.title: Gesture Log
awards.line: {name} gestured {n}x. Each was seen.

awards.title: Stationery Return

awards.title: Pace Review
awards.line: {name} sprinted {n}x. Walking remains a core value.

taken: Quota missed. The Company has repossessed {name}'s {upgrade}. Missed days: {misses} of {limit}. Please do not take it personally. We did.
The quota was not met. A roll was held and {name} loses {upgrade}. That is {misses} of {limit}. The dice send their regards.
Day {day} fell short. {name}'s {upgrade} has been reassigned to Nobody. Missed days: {misses} of {limit}.
taken_final: Quota missed again. {name}'s {upgrade} goes by roll, and so does your employment. Missed days: {misses} of {limit}. Game over.
That is {misses} of {limit}. {name} loses {upgrade} on the way out. The Company thanks you for your service. Game over.
empty: Quota missed. The roll found nothing to repossess. The Company will remember this. Missed days: {misses} of {limit}.
Day {day} fell short, and the crew owns no upgrades. The Company is reluctantly impressed. Missed days: {misses} of {limit}.
empty_final: That is {misses} of {limit}. There was nothing left to repossess, so the Company took the rest. Game over.
